newsitem.title: UK: Emirates hails UK cargo no-show penalty policy.
newsitem.headline: Emirates hails UK cargo no-show penalty policy.

text.p: Emirates said it has seen the almost complete elimination of its UK cargo 'no show' and late booking cancellation problems since it started penalising offending freight forwarders and shippers last November.

"We are finding we are not experiencing the no-show factor any more and have certainly got rid of those agents who would make triple bookings with us (and then not provide the promised cargo on time)," Jacqui Evans, the Dubai government-owned airline's UK cargo marketing controller, told a news briefing.
From November 1996, the carrier introduced penalty charges for cargo 'no-shows' relating to shipments of 4.5 tonnes and above.
Twenty-five percent of the shipment rate is charged for cancellations received 72 hours before departure, 50 percent for 48-hour cancellations and 75 percent for 24 hours.
